critique: Flawless execution of the dial geometry and typography: exactly 9 radial ticks on the upper arc with a completely blank bottom arc (no 5, 6, or 7 o'clock ticks), accurate beach labels, and a single burnt-orange pointer hand per dial. The matte navy ABS housing looks authentically molded without a glass cover, and the vintage recording studio setting with a Roland polyphonic synth and warm patch cables delivers exceptional editorial art direction.
